Lemma
[Evolution of the $P$-tensor] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0300, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0301 ↗ def:chow-ii-harnack-p-and-m-tensors 1. ch15:15.18\group Harnack Evolution Equations

\[ ( abla _t-\Delta )P_{abc}=2R_{adeb}P_{dec}+2R_{adec}P_{dbe} +2R_{bdec}P_{ade}-2R_{de} abla _dR_{abec}. \]
Proof

\sketch Apply the heat operator to $P_{abc}= abla _aR_{bc}- abla _bR_{ac}$. Commute it through each covariant derivative, substitute $( abla _t-\Delta )R_{bc}=2R_{bdec}R_{de}$, and use the second Bianchi identity. Grouping the three Ricci-derivative differences gives the three $P$-terms, while the differentiated curvature term is $-2R_{de} abla _dR_{abec}$.

□
